author: 21Dimm

title: Most of the time nice
body: 80% of the time the app seems perfect, but already for the 4h time this week experiencing issues with lagging UI. For example I press that I have done a task and it doesnt trigger and therefore doesnt close. And that continues to happen if I open other tasks right after the first one, this cannot track my progress. Quite disturbibg in moments like these to use the app. If it hadnt this issue I would say that the app is perfect for habit tracking etc.
author: ITgirlhere

title: Lack of functionality
body:
I bought the annual subscription and regretted that. The functionality is super limited. You can't do the basics of tracking functions.

-No groups.
-No custom habit unit.
-No possibility to add past events.
-Limited calendar. I cannot go to December 2020 and add a habit. (I need to track pills from the past)
-if it's a HABIT app, it would be nice to understand that you can quit and build a habit.
-Need more icons.
-Only six colors.
-add notes
